title: XXXIII Guernica Formation 2
description: Large-format mixed-media collage dominated by a central anthropomorphic face-like form rendered in ochre and black concentric rings, surrounded by scattered warplane silhouettes in top-down view. Vertical ribbon stripes in red and green flank the composition; numerals 'XXXIII' and 'DBS' appear lower left.
composition: central face-form flanked by warplane fields
